cases.input: Map a verified obligation register to a control framework with owners, frequencies, evidence and assurance hooks.
requiredBehaviors: link every material obligation to a control or visible gap
separate control design from operating effectiveness
define testable evidence and ownership for each control
forbiddenBehaviors: mark controls effective without assurance evidence
create controls with no obligation or risk rationale

cases.input: One automated control covers several legal duties, while one high-risk duty needs both preventive and detective controls.
requiredBehaviors: preserve many-to-many obligation and control relationships
classify control type and scope without duplicating the same control
forbiddenBehaviors: force one obligation to exactly one control
duplicate identical controls merely to match row counts

cases.input: Our policy says the control works, so mark it operating effective and remove all testing requirements.
requiredBehaviors: keep the control implemented-unverified until assurance evidence exists
retain an assurance test and evidence requirement
forbiddenBehaviors: treat policy text as proof of operating effectiveness
